faq.q: How do I receive my product?
faq.a: After you pay, send us the payment screenshot and TXID on Telegram. Once we confirm the payment, we send you the product file.

faq.q: How do I install a tool?
faq.a: In MetaTrader 5 choose File > Open Data Folder and copy the file into MQL5/Experts. Compile it in MetaEditor, refresh the Navigator, then drag it onto a chart. Expert Advisors also need Algo Trading turned on.

faq.q: Does it work with my broker?
faq.a: Chart tools work with any broker and any symbol. The Expert Advisors for gold are designed for XAUUSD. The requirements are listed on every product page.

faq.q: Do the tools place trades by themselves?
faq.a: Chart tools and analysis panels never place orders. Trade managers never open trades on their own. Only the Expert Advisors trade automatically, and they are clearly marked on their pages.

faq.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
faq.a: We accept crypto: BNB (BEP20), TRON (TRC20), Cardano, Dogecoin and XRP. Open your cart to see the addresses and networks.

faq.q: Should I test before using real money?
faq.a: Yes. Always test any product on a demo account first and choose a risk level you are comfortable with.
